utnn_mainParagraph: By implementing an effective succession planning process, you can precisely identify critical positions within your organization and develop possible successors in an appropriate and planned manner.
utnn_quoteParagraph: Systematic career development keeps the motivation of your talent on high levels and aids in the retention of the organization's best employees.
utnn_card1Heading: High-performing employees are less likely to leave.
utnn_card1Text: Appropriate succession planning minimizes the risk of losing your top employees. If you provide them with suitable career development, you will significantly increase their dedication and loyalty. As a result, the positive employer brand is boosted.
utnn_card2Heading: Cost savings associated with maintaining an adequate personnel structure.
utnn_card2Text: Internal talent that leaves after gaining skills indicates a permanent loss of financial investment in their development. Retention  of the organization's greatest staff is typically less expensive than recruiting and onboarding new employees.
utnn_card4Text: Appropriate succession planning enhances the pool of skilled employees that are able to fill critical positions in your company. This allows you to quickly fill in gaps caused by unexpected absences and to significantly lessen the disruptions to your business.
utnn_card3Text: Personal development programs designed specifically for colleagues help them to reach their maximum potential, which directly improves their performance. With the right career development, colleagues are more agile in resolving job challenges and coming up with new ideas.
utnn_Plan1Heading: Do you want to accomplish the following objectives?
utnn_Plan1Card1: Align HR planning with the company's overall strategy and desired business transformation.
utnn_Plan1Card2: Promptly identify and fill potential staffing gaps in critical positions.
utnn_Plan1Card3: Using objective assessment in order to evaluate the potential of your talents in a comprehensive manner.
utnn_Plan1Card4: Ensure that employees' competencies and potential are developed in a cost-effective manner.
utnn_Plan1Card5: Expand the pool of potential candidates for critical managerial and professional positions.
utnn_Plan1Card6: Assuring qualified successors on time, especially in case of unexpected events.
utnn_Plan2Heading: What do we have to offer?
utnn_Plan2Card1: A comprehensive process for identifying critical positions
utnn_Plan2Card2: A well-managed method for identifying talent and possible successors.
utnn_Plan2Card3: An objective assessment of competencies and personal potential using the DNLA system.
utnn_Plan2Card4: Individual development strategies to fill identified competencies gaps.
utnn_Plan2Card5: Accurate assessment of the capabilities of your talent  for taking over the critical positions in the company.
utnn_Plan2Card6: An operational succession pyramid for critical business positions.
utnn_bigArticle1Content: Today's business world is becoming extremely complex. We have to accept rapid and radical changes in our business. Even when it comes to attracting talented individuals, the business environment is tough, and the battle for talent is becoming increasingly competitive. This is why recognizing and managing talent and their careers is becoming extremely important.
utnn_bigArticle2Content: Each organization must preserve its business resiliency, growth capacity, innovative spirit, and competitive corporate culture. No success lasts permanently. This is why organizations today struggle to keep up with constantly changing demands for knowledge, skills, and experience, particularly in demanding / critical work positions. As a result, succession planning for critical business positions is becoming an extremely important part of making sure your organization stays competitive.
utnn_article1CardContent: Upravljanje talentov je strategija, s katero si podjetja zagotovijo, da so njihovi ključni, strokovno in osebnostno kompetentni posamezniki, deležni skrbne pozornosti
utnn_article2CardHeading: Mlajše generacije prevzemajo ključne vloge v organizacijah
utnn_article2CardContent: Eno izmed aktualnejših vprašanj v današnjem svetu, kjer je vrednota kapitala postala ena izmed glavnih vrednot, je vprašanje post-materializma in z njim povezanih razlik med generacijami.
utnn_article3CardContent: Osnovna vloga kadrovske službe je skrb za zaposlene od njihovega vstopa v organizacijo do konca njihove zaposlitve. Ali povedano drugače skrbeti za celoten življenjski cikel zaposlenega na način, da bo to potovanje zaposlenim zagotavljalo odlično osebno izkušnjo.
utnk_content: The talent management process is not an HR process; it is an organizational business process that must be established with strong support from the company's leaders on executive levels. It is a systematic and ongoing process for learning the skills and abilities that will help the organization meet its long-term goals.
utnk_list_heading: Talent and career management activities are focused on the following:
utnk_list_item1: Making sure that talent and young people with great potential are found and nurtured in the organization at the right time.
utnk_list_item2: Establishing a system for evaluating their potential.
utnk_list_item4: Retaining talent by providing mutually beneficial career paths.
utnk_list_item5: Recruiting and retaining talent in critical organizational positions.
utnk_tb1_text: The first stage in developing a talent management system is talent profiling. It is a strenuous process that requires the use of an objective system for evaluating their abilities, knowledge, and potential. It is crucial to identify the individual's career ambitions and areas of interest during the profiling process. In addition, it is also important to know exactly what are one's strengths, current skill level, and areas of improvement.
utnk_tb2_text: When we deal with talents, we are primarly interested in whether we know them well at all. With the DNLA Expert System, a cutting-edge tool, we enable our clients to assess the potential of the individuals. Our talent checker is straightforward and simple to use. Additionally, the program includes expert evaluation from an experienced consultant. We prepare detailed development strategies for your talents based on the DNLA analysis.
utnk_tb3_text: Creating a talent and key employee matrix is a time-consuming and delicate process. It demands precision, which is why it is conducted in collaboration with the professionals and management of each organizational unit. Our talent ranking methodology enables you to create talent matrices that aid you determine the development path of your talents in a consistent and efficient manner. We can assist you in developing and implementing a talent development strategy and programs.
nn_content: All people have an innate desire for personal and professional improvement. Therefore, it makes sense to identify your employees' professional ambitions early on and to determine where their talents, skills, and knowledge can be used.
nn_list_heading: Systematic career planning allows you to:
nn_list_item1: Identify critical positions for the future based on strategic orientations of the company.
nn_list_item2: A comprehensive analytical overview of your internal human potential/internal human capital.
nn_list_item3: Offering career opportunities to successful employees in your organization.
nn_list_item4: Implementation of the talent development on time.
nn_list_item5: Replacement of retired employees with highly qualified successors on time.
nn_list_item6: Ensure continuity in the organization's management and professional growth.
nn_tb1_text: Each organization has important business roles and associated jobs that are critical to the long term organization's success. Therefore, it is essential to recognize them as soon as possible. The most important thing is to agree on the nature (key criterias) of these jobs and then prepare operational succession pyramids for them.
nn_tb2_text: Successors are those colleagues who have a high level of competence, are highly motivated, and perform excellently. Based on their track record, we may expect that they will succeed even if they take on more challenging and responsible jobs.
nn_tb3_text: The career conversation is essential to the process. The individual discusses his or her career ambitions and makes career decisions during the interview with the aid of his or her manager and internal professional staff. It is a type of counselling that helps people figure out what they want to do in the future and how their ambitions match up with the needs of the company.
nn_tb4_text: The succession pyramid is a structured representation of current responsibility holders and future successors for important business positions. In a succession pyramid, people who have met the criteria needed for the job are put together. Accordingly their development can be quickly directed toward meeting the job's specific needs.
nn_tb5_text: Prior to assigning successors to new work positions, we must ensure that they have the best possible start. We need to assist them in identifying and comprehending the responsibilities and expectations associated with their new employment. This type of support is crucial for both immediate and ongoing success at the new work position. We recommend one-on-one coaching and/or the support of an experienced mentor.
